basic_details.job_title: PM SHRI Govt. U.G. High School, Bakoda Guest Faculty Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Guest Faculties are being engaged to teach Higher Secondary (+2) classes in the Arts stream (Odia, English, History, Economics, Political Science and Opt Odia) for 2026-27 at PM Shree Govt. UG Higher Secondary School, Bakoda, in Umerkote block of Nabarangpur district, under Advertisement No-01/2026. Applications in the prescribed format must reach the Principal on or before 10 November 2026. Retired Govt and Aided College/HSS teachers are invited first. If such teachers are not available, fresh candidates will be selected.

content_sections.heading: About UGHSS Bakoda
content_sections.text: PM Shree Govt. UG Higher Secondary School, Bakoda is a government higher secondary school at Bakoda in Umerkote block of Nabarangpur district (PIN 764073). The engagement notice has been issued by the Principal for the academic year 2026-27. The Principal has asked the District Coordinator (DeGM), Collector, Nabarangpur to upload it on the District NIC portal, and copies have been sent to the Block Education Office, Umerkote and the District Education Office, Nabarangpur for display on their notice boards.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Office of the Principal, PM Shree Govt. UG Higher Secondary School, Bakoda, At/Post Bakoda, Block Umerkote, District Nabarangpur, PIN 764073 The notice does not specify a postal mode or what to write on the envelope. Self-attested copies of the documents listed under Enclosures must be attached to the application form. For queries, the school's email address is [email protected] and the contact number is 9937936973. The notice states that the details can be obtained from the website http://nabarangpur.odisha.gov.in .

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The post is Guest Faculty to teach in Higher Secondary Classes (+2) in the Arts stream. The subjects offered are: Odia English History Economics Political Science Opt Odia Applications are invited from retired Govt and Aided College/HSS teachers. The notice prints the age as "65 year of age". In case of non-availability of teachers, fresh candidates will be selected. Master Degree in the concerned subject with at least 50% mark or equivalent grade, AND B.Ed or equivalent degree, recognised by the NCTE New Delhi in case of B.Ed subject. Candidates should check the official notification for the subject-specific eligibility for each subject. Guest Faculties engaged will be paid @Rs400/- per class/lecture of 45 minutes duration, subject to a ceiling of maximum 50 classes with Rs20,000/- per month. The notice does not mention any other allowance. The engagement is purely temporary in nature. It will continue till the closure of the school for the next summer vacation of 2026-27 or the posting of a PGT in the school, whichever is earlier. The Principal reserves the right to disengage a Guest Faculty by giving one month's notice if performance is not satisfactory.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Self-attested copies of these documents must be attached with the application form: HSC or equivalent certificate and mark sheet +2 or equivalent certificate and mark sheet Bachelor Degree or equivalent certificate and mark sheet Master degree or equivalent certificate and mark sheet B.Ed degree or equivalent certificate and mark sheet Certificate of computer knowledge Experience certificate ID proof/Address proof

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection of Guest Faculties at UGHSS Bakoda will be made on the basis of: Career assessment Teaching experience Basic experience in computer application Document verification will be held on 12 November 2026, from 10.00 am to 2.00 pm , in the office of the Principal. No TA/DA will be admissible for attending the document verification.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for UGHSS Bakoda Guest Faculty 2026?
faq.answer: The application must reach the Principal, PM Shree Govt. UG Higher Secondary School, Bakoda, on or before 10 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What qualification is needed for Guest Faculty at UGHSS Bakoda?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Master Degree in the concerned subject with at least 50% mark or equivalent grade AND a B.Ed or equivalent degree, recognised by the NCTE New Delhi in case of B.Ed subject.

faq.question: Q3. Who can apply for the UGHSS Bakoda Guest Faculty posts?
faq.answer: Retired Govt and Aided College/HSS teachers are invited first, with the notice printing "65 year of age". Fresh candidates will be selected if such teachers are not available.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of a Guest Faculty at UGHSS Bakoda?
faq.answer: A Guest Faculty will be paid Rs400/- per class of 45 minutes, subject to a ceiling of maximum 50 classes with Rs20,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. How to apply for UGHSS Bakoda Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill the application in the prescribed format, attach self-attested copies of the eight listed documents, and send it so that it reaches the Office of the Principal, PM Shree Govt. UG Higher Secondary School, Bakoda, At/Post Bakoda, Block Umerkote, District Nabarangpur, PIN 764073, by 10 November 2026.

faq.question: Q6. How will Guest Faculties be selected at UGHSS Bakoda?
faq.answer: Selection will be made through career assessment, teaching experience and basic experience in computer application, with document verification on 12 November 2026 from 10.00 am to 2.00 pm in the office of the Principal.

faq.question: Q7. Is TA/DA given for the document verification?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA shall be admissible for document verification.

faq.question: Q8. Is the UGHSS Bakoda Guest Faculty job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is purely temporary and continues till the closure of the school for the next summer vacation of 2026-27 or the posting of a PGT in the school, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q9. Which subjects are offered for Guest Faculty at UGHSS Bakoda?
faq.answer: The Arts stream subjects offered are Odia, English, History, Economics, Political Science and Opt Odia.
